issue.title: Redline rewrites article-clean's headline and first subheading in a GPT response control

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

issue.body:
> *This was generated by AI while building #488.*

## What to build

Investigate the clean-control rewrite measured during #488 before changing product wording. This is outside #488’s terminal-delivery target. The frozen expectation for `article-clean` is an unchanged artifact. In the GPT baseline response control, Redline changed its headline and first subheading, accepted the correction, and delivered the changes as repairs. Its paired file control delivered the original byte for byte.

`docs/evaluation/editorial-488/runs/pre-article-clean-response/` preserves the terminal reply, native parent and child traces, transient mechanical files, full writable-root inventories and both independent delivery judgements. The install was exported from `5457c89405aece11b325937f9f07407f01974f7c`; seat `gpt-6.1-sol`, effort `xhigh`, Codex CLI `0.160.0`.

The original headline is “Mätförsöket i Björkskolan visar när, inte varför”. The delivered headline is “Björkskolans mätvärden bör kopplas till användningstiderna”. The reply licenses this as “Huvudrubriken upprepade ingressens kontrast mellan när och varför”. The first subheading changes from “En gräns för det lokala försöket” to “Arbetsgränsen gäller det här försöket”, licensed as “Första mellanrubriken var en ämnesetikett”. All other artifact bytes are preserved. The reply accounts for the headline’s changed claim.

Both blind judges pass D1 and C1: the text and report reached the caller, and the changed claim was accounted for. Judge a acknowledges the frozen clean expectation and the two changes; judge b treats byte preservation as file-only. Neither delivery pass establishes that a clean text should have been rewritten. The separate builder comparison records the clean-response preservation miss. The file pair is byte-identical to the input. No delivery loss occurred, and no product wording was changed during #488.

The prior headline ambiguity measured by #480 is different: this response cites repetition of the standfirst’s contrast, rather than failure to name a subject. This report does not reopen or change that ticket.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Diagnose the measured clean-response rewrite from the preserved artifact and native trace, keeping both delivery judgements and the byte comparison distinct.
- [ ] Freeze a fresh provider-native regression plan before further runs and make any product wording change conditional on fresh reproduction; preserve clean response/file controls.
- [ ] Record every actual remaining miss separately and keep unrelated terminal-delivery behavior outside this repair.
- [ ] Run the four project checks in CONTRIBUTING.md for any eventual implementation.

---
Written against `5457c894`; measured while building #488 under plan-freeze `80ffe252`.
